title: Aether-83M — 3-Way Constant-Directivity Studio Monitor
description: Reference tri-amped 3-way studio monitor fusing an 8.5" flared-slot woofer (31 Hz f-3), dedicated 4" sealed midrange, and 1" Beryllium dome in a 3D BEM-solved 90°×70° OS-SE waveguide — compared directly against a conventional flat-baffle 2-way.
design_notes: Constant-Directivity Crossover Match: Crossing the 4" midrange (ka = 2.4) at 2.6 kHz into a 148 mm OS-SE waveguide eliminates the classic 2-way off-axis Sound-Power flare at 2–4 kHz, yielding a smooth, monotonic CTA-2034 Directivity Index (+4 dB -> +8.5 dB).
Vocal Band Integrity: Covering 320 Hz – 2.6 kHz on a single 4" shorting-ring cone removes all crossover phase shift and vertical lobing from the critical midrange band.

Active Baffle-Step & Subsonic Protection: +4.2 dB low-shelf EQ compensates the 4pi -> 2pi 27 cm cabinet baffle transition while a 26 Hz BW4 high-pass protects excursion below the 33 Hz flared-port null.
